source_note: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明
english_source_note: A Probabilistic Proof of the Weierstrass Approximation Theorem
callout_id: Weierstrass逼近定理的概率途径证明#8
statement_en:
Consider $n$ independent and identically distributed random variables $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ on a probability space $(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$, each with Bernoulli$(p)$ distribution. Determine the distribution of their average
$$Y_n = \frac{X_1+\cdots+X_n}{n}.$$
key_techniques: distribution of sums of independent Bernoulli variables
callout_body: 考虑概率空间$(\Omega,\mathcal{F},P)$上的n个满足bernoulli(p)分布的独立同分布的随机变量$X_1,...,X_n$，考虑其“平均值”$$Y_n = \frac{X_1+...+X_n}{n}$$的分布。
